title: Mudhorn
subtitle: Creature
description: In the dark and muddy caves of Arvala-7, great, lumbering mudhorns could be found. These wooly creatures protected themselves with their massive horns and were defensive of their territory, doing their best to keep Jawas or any other nefarious ne'er-do-wells from stealing their precious eggs. Only with Grogu's help was the Mandalorian able to defeat the mudhorn.
